title: Signed-in local public password change
summary: Signed-in local public accounts can change their password on Profile. Directory and Cloudron accounts continue to manage passwords in Cloudron.
changes: Add current, new, and confirm password fields on Profile for local service-user accounts.
Require the current password; keep the signed-in session after a successful change and invalidate other sessions.
Hide the change-password form for Cloudron directory, pending first-login, hybrid, and staff-eligible accounts.
Set current-password and new-password autocomplete hints on the Profile password fields.
version_rationale: Minor release: adds a signed-in password-change path for local public accounts without changing Cloudron directory sign-in.
validation: PHPUnit ProfileLocalPasswordChangeTest covers local public change versus directory, Cloudron, pending first-login, hybrid, and staff refusal, plus current-password and confirmation checks, autocomplete hints, and no dashboard password form.
Related public auth and profile tests remain green. No impersonation control is present, and password values are not stored in audit history.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the public local forgot-password parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: Read-only account email on Profile remains a separate change. Directory and Cloudron passwords continue to be managed in Cloudron.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Passwords already changed through this flow remain in effect until the account holder or an administrator sets a new password.
provenance: Defined by the signed-in local public password-change task for MyAPES Account issue #147 under parent #121 and epic #158 and pull request #162.
